description: Upload an ad video from a public URL or a local file. Returns video ID for use in ad creatives.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to upload into (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

file_path.description: Local filesystem path of the video to upload. Sent as multipart/form-data, bypassing the need for a publicly reachable URL.

file_url.description: Public URL of the video to upload

name: upload_video
